scope: Bounded inspection of author documentation, configuration and model source through retrieved public webpages. No weights, training images or runtime model execution.

pins.candidate_revision_evidence: Full SHA exposed by the commit link from the retrieved Hugging Face main tree; the immutable commit/configuration fetch was inaccessible.
limitations: Author GitHub immutable revision was not recoverable through the available reader.
The Hugging Face API endpoint and immutable revision routes were inaccessible.
Retrieved webpages have different crawl dates. Mutable main-file observations must not be treated as one freshly bound snapshot.
No byte-level source or weight integrity claim is made.

integration_findings.finding: The retrieved configuration enables return_all_tokens. The inspected forward method returns all non-masked patch tokens under that setting; it does not default to one fixed-size vector per image.
integration_findings.next_action: Define and test CLS-token output with return_all_tokens disabled or an explicit pooling rule before retrieval. Freeze this choice without tuning on held-out results.

integration_findings.finding: The inspected forward signature is forward(x, index, list_num_channels). Its tokenization receives flattened single-channel image batches and splits them according to grouping metadata.
integration_findings.next_action: Build and test a channel-group adapter. Do not assume that an ordinary B-by-C-by-H-by-W tensor can be passed unchanged to this author wrapper.

integration_findings.finding: The in_chans value of one describes each patchifier input; the separate maximum channel count is ten.
integration_findings.next_action: Preserve biological channel identities and sample boundaries while preparing the grouped input.

integration_findings.finding: The retrieved author GitHub pyproject declares an older development stack including NumPy 1.24.3 and Torch 2.0.0.
integration_findings.next_action: Assess a separate model runtime. Do not install that dependency set into Perturb-LM's recently repaired NumPy 2 environment.

integration_findings.finding: The model configuration maps Transformers auto classes to repository-specific Python modules. The model-page usage requests trust_remote_code.
integration_findings.next_action: Pin and review the exact custom source before any loading. This audit did not import or execute it.

training.limitation: No experiment-by-experiment training inventory was reconciled against the proposed JUMP evaluation cohort. Self-supervised training does not establish independence.

license.limitation: The code license was not silently extended to every checkpoint artifact.

unresolved_preprocessing: Intensity scaling and normalization for the selected five-channel TIFFs
Crop and resize choices for the selected image cohort
Registration and missing-channel behavior on actual inputs
